caveats: Unweighted, self-selected sample of Stack Overflow-engaged developers; not population estimates.
Associations only; stated sentiment, not observed behaviour.
2026 is a separate series (question wording/definition changed); never connect 2026 to 2023-2025 with a line.
Attitude items (favourable, trust, complexity) are among current AI users only; user definition changes in 2025 and 2026.
Heavy late-survey dropout in 2025-2026; CIs ignore self-selection and dropout (see Manski bounds in FINDINGS.md).

meta.population: Adult professional current AI users answering accuracy trust and use frequency; same professional base as the trends.
meta.method: Grouped binomial logistic regression; marginal probabilities standardised to the observed covariate mix. Coding experience uses the existing bands; implausible years are marked Missing.
meta.uncertainty: 95% model-based coefficient-normal simulation intervals, 4000 draws; conditional on the fitted main-effects model and observed sample. Independent-response/model assumptions; no correction for survey selection, module dropout or unmeasured confounding.
meta.interpretation: Exploratory follow-up selected after seeing the raw frequency gradient, not preregistered. Contemporary association, not evidence that use causes trust or that this explains the cross-year trend. Missing-category and complete-case analyses target different samples.
meta.source_hash_format: Source hashes normalise CRLF to LF; data hash uses exact bytes.

issues.decision: Use the hash-verified public archive and our declared QC base. Do not remove 182 arbitrary rows or claim exact reproduction of the published topline.
